name: ruflo-swarm
description: Agent teams, swarm coordination, Monitor streams, and worktree isolation — wraps 4 swarm_* + 8 agent_* MCP tools (12 total) plus 6 topologies (hierarchical / mesh / hierarchical-mesh / ring / star / adaptive). With Claude Code function hooks on (early access), a live swarm pane: agent tiles lit by reads and writes, topology, task and claims board, cost, router pick and hive-mind votes, with buttons that act through the ruflo CLI

panel.title: Swarm pane
panel.description: command (default) opens the pane only with /ruflo swarm pane (or its alias /ruflo-swarm-pane, or /ruflo-swarm:watch); auto also opens it when a ruflo swarm is on disk and the layout docks panes (ruflo-console's cockpit is the pane that opens by itself now); off never opens it.

cli.title: ruflo CLI
cli.description: How the pane's buttons reach ruflo. npx-offline (default) uses the locally cached @claude-flow/cli and never touches the network; npx may download it; ruflo and claude-flow use a global install.

routeThreshold.title: Router confidence threshold
routeThreshold.description: A router pick under this confidence (0 to 1) is shown as below threshold, with its score, rather than as a match.

injectSpawnContext.title: Swarm note in subagent prompts
injectSpawnContext.description: Append a short note naming the ruflo swarm (id, topology, strategy, read from disk) to the prompt of each subagent Claude Code spawns.

injectAdrs.title: ADRs in subagent prompts
injectAdrs.description: When a ruflo-console mission has ADRs attached, append the accepted decisions (a short, masked digest from .claude-flow/console/adr-digest.json) to the prompt of each subagent Claude Code spawns. Nothing is added when no ADR is attached.

audit.title: Audit trail
audit.description: Record a bounded trail of engine events (event and tool names, agent ids, times; never prompts, arguments or results) into ruflo memory namespace ruflo-swarm-audit every 30 seconds.
